in_marathi.name: Hemlatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth, prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemlatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hemlatha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hema’ which means gold or wealth and ‘latha’ which means flow. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that the name Hemlatha brings good fortune and abundance in one's life.
